summary: Retest of the plans-hiding fix, frontend only, at 390x844. PASS. Failed /api/launch-offer (aborted with page.route, waited 12-15s through react-query retries, about 4 attempts per page): no paid wording, no ₹ prices and no plan names appeared on /, /auth/register, /plans, /membership, /job/:id, /account or /dashboard, as guest or as logged-in candidate. LaunchOfferCard rendered nothing (count 0). Slow request (5s delay): checked at 1.5/3/4.5/6/10s on /, /plans, /auth/register and job detail; always clean, and the card appears after load. With plans_hidden=false, prices (₹599/₹799), 'Membership Plans', 'View Membership Plans', 'Become a Member' and 'Choose a membership' come back on home, /plans and job detail. Settings were restored to enabled:true, plans_hidden:true, 100, 90 (verified via GET). Dashboard section title reads 'Payments' with the 'No payment needed' card and no ₹. Guest /membership header reads 'My Access'. Logged-in non-member job detail shows 'See My Access' and goes to /membership, both normally and with launch-offer failing. Non-member state was simulated by rewriting the /api/auth/me membership in the browser, because test_iter9_nomem_c7dd7d@example.com no longer exists (login returns 401) and registering was not allowed. No page errors. Deprecated packages detected: none checked anew (iteration 9 found none).

issues: Header is hardcoded 'Membership' (app/plans.tsx:93). Consider 'Free Access' or 'My Access' to match the rest of the hidden-mode copy.

The copy 'Membership opening soon / Paid membership plans are not open yet' still mentions paid membership plans (src/components/LaunchOffer.tsx:58-59). Optional wording tweak if the user wants zero membership mentions.

action_items: Optional: change the /plans hidden-mode header from 'Membership' to neutral copy (app/plans.tsx:93).
Optional: soften the 'Paid membership plans are not open yet' copy in LaunchOfferCard for logged-in non-members.
critical_code_review_comments: useLaunchOffer returns q.data ?? PLACEHOLDER (plans_hidden:true), and LaunchOfferCard returns null when isPlaceholderData is set. This correctly fails closed.
In the failure case a logged-in non-member on /membership sees only the status card and no explanation card. Acceptable, but nothing tells them free access is pending.
seed_data_creation: None. Launch settings were toggled to plans_hidden=false and restored to enabled:true, plans_hidden:true, free_spots:100, free_days:90.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DB now holds real users. test_iter9_nomem_c7dd7d@example.com is gone. To test a non-member without registering, rewrite /api/auth/me in Playwright (route.fetch, then fulfill with membership {is_active:false}). test@jobradar.com is still an active demo member (expires 12 Mar 2027). Toggle settings with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... python3 /app/backend/tests/iter9_toggle_helper.py set <enabled> <hidden>.
rca_of_issue: The iteration 10 failed-request leak was fixed by falling back to PLACEHOLDER when the query has no data, so fetch errors keep plans hidden.
